releaseNotes:
v4.8.0 - 2026-10-17
- feat: per-client access tokens with their own tool, read/write and connection access (#551)
  - New under Advanced settings: per-client access tokens (firmware 2.5.2 or later). Give an MCP client its own token (all tools on to start) and choose exactly which tools it can call, whether it can read or write, whether it can connect locally or through the cloud, and its own tool-name number. The main token is unchanged.
    - A client sees only its own tools, and a refused call tells it which setting blocks it. A client token can never read or change the MCP Rule Server app itself, and access tokens are always masked in its results.
    - Rotating or revoking a client token takes effect immediately and leaves every other client working.
